gaps.explanation: The governmental funds statement (trimmed p4) prints Transfers in 165,000 in the General Fund column and 39,056 in the Debt Service Fund column, Total 204,056. The schedules print the same amounts with different labels. The General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p8) prints the 165,000 under Other Financing Sources as 'Advances from other city funds', and it is already in detail at index 19 (section other financing, +165,000, original_label 'Advances from other city funds'). The Debt Service Fund schedule (p9) prints Transfers in 39,056, detail index 29. 39,056 + 165,000 = 204,056, so nothing is missing. The gap comes only from the schedule calling the 165,000 an advance (the Statement of Activities calls it 'Advances from Combined Utilities') rather than a transfer. Adding a Transfers In line would count the 165,000 twice, so there is no fix.
